author: /root/he_ephase_validation
targetDescription: Die lernende Person kann Aufbau und Funktionsprinzip eines Transformators mit Induktion erklären, beim idealen Transformator Spannungs- und Stromstärkeübersetzungen berechnen und die gegenläufige Übersetzung mit Energieerhaltung begründen.

independentCalculations.constantFlux: dPhi/dt=0 gives no sustained induced secondary voltage.
independentCalculations.bothRatiosGreaterThanOne: (U2/U1)*(I2/I1)=P2/P1=1 rules this out for the specified lossless loaded model.

manualContentReview.completeIndependentPerformances: Each case independently requires a labelled source/core/windings/load sketch, causal flux/induction explanation, voltage and current ratios, and a justified energy balance. B additionally checks constant flux.
manualContentReview.DE_EN: Both languages agree on all values, turns, RMS quantities, steady sinusoidal operation, resistive loads, ignored losses/magnetising current, questions, reference calculations and rubric.
manualContentReview.physicalValidity: Purely resistive loads and negligible magnetising current explicitly establish power factor1 for this ideal model, so P=U_rms*I_rms legitimately denotes real power. No undefined phase assumption or real DC experiment is introduced.
manualContentReview.genuineCoverage: Both cases cover transformer structure/function through induction, voltage and current transformations, and inverse ratios justified by conservation, exactly matching the complete target. Formula and modelling assumptions are supplied; no motor construction or unrelated goal is required.
manualContentReview.rubric: All seven core performances are separately noncompensable, including each complete case and the constant-flux reasoning. Equivalent correct schematic arrangements and ratio derivations remain accepted.
manualContentReview.courseBoundary: Task and covered transformer target both permit GK and LK, with no course expansion.

limitations: AI independent content and numeric review; no human review or learner effectiveness claim.
Source-stage task selection and final actual CQR/routes are separate integration checks.
Release may change only reviewStatus/reviewNote without a new content review.
